The ANDRO Consortium which consists of the
Australian National Line, Neptune Orient Lines, Over-
seas Containers Australia and Nedlloyd Lines, will be

annotations.label: Article Body
annotations.ocr_text:
operating three hybrid roll-on roll-off, lift-on lift-off
container vessels between Australian ports and
Penang, Port Kelang, Singapore and Jarkarta. This
service will be on an 11-day-day frequency.

On board the MV ‘Bennelong’ recently, the ANRO
consortium played host to members of the Malayan
Trade Mission on a Sydney harbour cruise and bar-
beque. Seen in the picture are, from left: Mr. A.R.
Booth, ANL, Mr. Jim Lim, NOL, Mr. Lim Seng Huat,
Malaysian Commissioner for Trade, Sydney, Mr. Mar-
tin:Speyer, OCAL, Mr. J.C.P. Van Diepen, Nedlloyd
Lines and Mr. Aziz Kassim, member of the trade
mission.
